bio: In what was once Roermond's prison, you will be served bread and water first of all. But fear not: any culinary nods to the past vocation of the premises end there. At this restaurant, which is part of Het Arresthuis hotel, historical details and contemporary design elegantly intertwine. Chef Jeroen van Gansewinkel masterfully incorporates international influences and rich sauces into his dishes. From lamb with typically Middle Eastern seasonings such as za'atar and smoked paprika to langoustine with a tangy beurre blanc infused with basil oil, the food is complex and brimming with flavour. As they say themselves – it's criminally delicious!...
